class.name: OcgGpVec2d
class.brief_description: Defines a non-persistent vector in 2D space.
class.description: ! Defines a non-persistent vector in 2D space.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a zero vector.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a unitary vector from a direction theV.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a vector with a doublet of coordinates.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a point with its two Cartesian coordinates.

method.name: from_5
method.description: Creates a vector from two points. The length of the vector is the distance between theP1 and theP2

method.name: SetCoord_1
method.description: Changes the coordinate of range theIndex theIndex = 1 => X is modified theIndex = 2 => Y is modified Raises OutOfRange if theIndex != {1, 2}.

method.name: SetCoord_2
method.description: For this vector, assigns the values theXv and theYv to its two coordinates

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this vector.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Y coordinate of this vector.

method.name: SetXY
method.description: Assigns the two coordinates of theCoord to this vector.

method.name: Coord_1
method.description: Returns the coordinate of range theIndex : theIndex = 1 => X is returned theIndex = 2 => Y is returned Raised if theIndex != {1, 2}.

method.name: Coord_2
method.description: For this vector, returns its two coordinates theXv and theYv

method.name: X
method.description: For this vector, returns its X coordinate.

method.name: Y
method.description: For this vector, returns its Y coordinate.

method.name: XY
method.description: For this vector, returns its two coordinates as a number pair

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns True if the two vectors have the same magnitude value and the same direction. The precision values are theLinearTolerance for the magnitude and theAngularTolerance for the direction.

method.name: IsNormal
method.description: Returns True if abs(Abs(<me>.Angle(theOther)) - PI/2.) <= theAngularTolerance Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp.

method.name: IsOpposite
method.description: Returns True if PI - Abs(<me>.Angle(theOther)) <= theAngularTolerance Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp.

method.name: IsParallel
method.description: Returns true if Abs(Angle(<me>, theOther)) <= theAngularTolerance or PI - Abs(Angle(<me>, theOther)) <= theAngularTolerance Two vectors with opposite directions are considered as parallel. Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angular value between <me> and <theOther> returns the angle value between -PI and PI in radian. The orientation is from <me> to theOther. The positive sense is the trigonometric sense. Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution because the angular value is indefinite if one of the vectors has a null magnitude.

method.name: Magnitude
method.description: Computes the magnitude of this vector.

method.name: SquareMagnitude
method.description: Computes the square magnitude of this vector.

method.name: Added
method.description: Adds two vectors

method.name: Crossed
method.description: Computes the crossing product between two vectors

method.name: CrossMagnitude
method.description: Computes the magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||

method.name: CrossSquareMagnitude
method.description: Computes the square magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||**2

method.name: Divided
method.description: divides a vector by a scalar

method.name: Dot
method.description: Computes the scalar product

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Normalizes a vector Raises an exception if the magnitude of the vector is lower or equal to Resolution from package gp.

method.name: Normalized
method.description: Normalizes a vector Raises an exception if the magnitude of the vector is lower or equal to Resolution from package gp. Reverses the direction of a vector

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the direction of a vector

method.name: Subtract
method.description: Subtracts two vectors

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: Subtracts two vectors

method.name: SetLinearForm_4
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2 + theV3

method.name: SetLinearForm_3
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2

method.name: SetLinearForm_2
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theV2

method.name: SetLinearForm_1
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theV1 + theV2

method.name: Mirror_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to the vector theV which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to the vector theV which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirror_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a vector. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a vector. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a vector with a Trsf from gp.
